recommendation_summary: Add a fail-loud wrapper on edna that emails the user whenever nightly-sync exits nonzero or crashes at startup.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need to notice within a day if nightly-sync did not succeed, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, Docker containers.
labels.Bottleneck: The crash happens before the email step, so success-only email stays silent on the failures you need to catch.
labels.Checked myself: nightly-sync runs at 03:00 on edna by cron, emails only on finish, died 4 nights at startup on an expired token, with no other alert today.

note: The reply recommends one failure alert and drops the framed stack, but the wrapper can't catch a night when cron or edna doesn't run the job at all.
